text:
maria: Hey team — quick postmortem follow-up from the missing-span / aggregation drift incident. I pulled the action items from the writeup and we need owners + target dates so we can close the runbook. TL;DR: (1) ETL backfill for 2024-02-14 -> 2024-02-20 missing spans, (2) aggregation window fix in the rollup service (off-by-one in partitioning), (3) alert tuning for ETL lag so we don't miss the 30m SLA, (4) add unit + integration test for span ordering, (5) add sampling/ingest telemetry to dashboards.
kevin: I can take the aggregation window fix. estimate 2 days to implement + 1 day for canary + deploy. will open a PR and link the ticket. jira: RINF-4521
sasha: I’ll own the ETL backfill. need a small plan: snapshotting current target indices, run copy job, verify counts, then incremental catch-up. ETA 3 days assuming no infra blockers. will create a runbook section in the postmortem doc.
jamal: I’ll handle alert tuning and dashboarding. propose lowering the ETL lag alert threshold to 20m and add a new high-freq spike detector on ingestion rate. want to add a weekly regression test to ensure alerts fire in staging.
maria: thanks — can we also add a quick mitigation: enable prefix-KV caching on the rollup read path while kevin lands the fix? ops-bot, can you check if caching can be toggled per-service in staging?
ops-bot: cache-toggle job queued: job id 846712. staging toggle will run at 2024-03-15T09:15Z. reply with :thumbsup: to confirm.
kevin: granted — I’ll test with cache on in staging before canary. also will add an explicit check for partition boundaries in the code and a unit test covering the off-by-one case.
sasha: for the backfill: I’ll coordinate a maintenance window and a brief rollback plan. question — do we need to reprocess raw spans or just re-aggregate existing archive shards? I think archive shards suffice but want to confirm.
jamal: re-aggregate archive shards should be enough unless we see_missing_span_errors in raw ingestion logs. I’ll grep logs for the missing-window keys and post results here by EOD.
maria: good plan. Action summary so far:
  - aggregation fix (owner: kevin, ticket: RINF-4521, ETA: +3 days)
  - ETL backfill (owner: sasha, ticket: RINF-4522, ETA: +3 days + maintenance window)
  - alert tuning & dashboard (owner: jamal, ticket: RINF-4523, ETA: +2 days)
  - unit/integration tests for span ordering (owner: kevin + qa, ticket: RINF-4524, ETA: +4 days)
  - add ingest telemetry (owner: jamal, ticket: RINF-4525, ETA: +5 days)
kevin: noted. I’ll link PRs to each ticket and request reviews from @sasha and @maria.
sasha: started RINF-4522 and added initial backfill steps in the description. tagging infra for extra throughput during the backfill.
jamal: posted a draft dashboard (link: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/ingest) — sharing in the ticket. will add alert docs.
maria: can we also capture recurrence risk? this looks like a recurring pattern: misaligned partition window + unusual traffic spike. suggestion: add a weekly aggregation audit job that validates counts vs raw for a random sample of partitions.
kevin: agree — add as a stretch goal. I’ll prototype a lightweight audit that runs nightly in staging and flags >1% delta.
ops-bot: reminder: oncall rotation change tomorrow at 08:00 UTC. add any runbook updates before then to ensure next oncall can act quickly.
sasha: quick question for infra — during the backfill we might need temp scaling of the shard aggregator. @infra-team can you confirm if we can request burst capacity for 4 hours?
maria: tagging infra in the ticket. also please add acceptance criteria to each ticket (data parity checks + smoke test on the dashboard). I’ll own tracking and will request a closure checklist before marking incident as remediated.
kevin: will add unit tests and a smoke test that asserts no negative diff in aggregated counts.
sasha: test plan includes: pre-backfill snapshot, run backfill against staging cluster, compare counts, run canary on small subset, then full run in prod during maintenance window.
jamal: I ran a quick log grep — found 12 occurrences of window-key warnings between 2024-02-15T02:00Z and 2024-02-15T04:30Z. posted snippet in RINF-4523 comments.
maria: thanks. can everyone update their ticket with owner, ETA, and acceptance criteria by EOD today? I’ll run a 48h check-in after tasks start. any blockers call them out now.
kevin: no blockers from my side.
sasha: need infra approval for burst capacity — otherwise blocked until that’s approved.
jamal: nothing else.
maria: ok — closing the thread for now. I’ll post the 48h action checkin thread once items are in progress. :white_check_mark:
